q: Menurut kajian kes Bright Sparklers, punca letupan ialah:
c: Eksperimen dengan bahan kimia letupan oleh pengurus kilang yang mencetuskan kebakaran
e: Cause: experiment with explosive chemicals by a factory manager (chemist) triggered a fire that spread to stored fireworks ('bazookas').

q: Media menggelar tragedi Bright Sparklers sebagai:
c: "Hiroshima of Sungai Buloh"
e: Public reaction: dubbed the 'Hiroshima of Sungai Buloh' – media highlighted the traumatic scale of destruction.

q: Prinsip 'fleksibiliti' dalam SSI bermaksud:
c: Pemeriksaan disesuaikan dengan profil risiko, bukan sekadar selang tetap
w: Pemilik boleh memilih untuk tidak diperiksa
e: Principles: flexibility – inspections tailored to risk profile, not just fixed intervals; risk prioritisation (PoF × CoF); compliance assurance.

q: Skim B di bawah SSI sesuai untuk peralatan seperti:
c: Tangki simpanan dan sistem bertekanan rendah
e: Scheme B: longer CF (36–60 months) for low/medium-risk equipment (storage tanks, low-pressure systems), based on RBI accepted by DOSH.

q: Kaedah pemeriksaan bagi Skim A ialah:
c: Pemeriksaan berasaskan masa (time-based)
e: Comparison: Scheme A – high-risk, shorter CF (1–2 years), time-based inspection; Scheme B – lower-risk, longer CF (3–5 years), RBI.

q: Dalam aliran proses SSI, langkah ke-3 ialah:
c: JKKP menyemak dan meluluskan selang pemeriksaan (Skim A atau B)
e: Process flow: 1 Application, 2 Risk Assessment by CP, 3 Approval by DOSH, 4 Inspection Execution, 5 CF Issuance, 6 Monitoring & Renewal.

q: Semasa melaksanakan pemeriksaan (langkah 4), Orang Kompeten menggunakan kaedah:
c: Ujian tanpa musnah (NDT) dan merekod penemuan
e: Step 4 – Inspection Execution: CP carries out inspection, applies NDT methods, records findings.

q: Siapakah yang dianggap 'penghuni' (occupier) di bawah SSI?
c: Sesiapa atau syarikat yang mengawal premis atau peralatan
e: Occupier = any person/company in control of the premises/equipment; non-delegable duty.

q: Pemeriksa yang dilantik untuk SSI, contohnya, mempunyai pensijilan:
e: Duties of Occupier: ensure inspections carried out by CPs (e.g., API 510/570/653 certified).

q: Bagi permohonan SSI, bukti yang perlu dikemukakan termasuk:
c: Bukti pelantikan pemeriksa yang kompeten
e: Application: equipment details, Risk Assessment Report (Scheme B), proof of competent inspector appointment, payment of fees.

q: Akibat ketidakpatuhan SSI boleh meliputi:
c: Penggantungan atau pembatalan CF serta liabiliti kepada pengarah dan pengurusan
e: Non-compliance: fines, suspension or revocation of CF, prosecution, liability may extend to directors and management.

q: Tujuan Pemeriksaan Khas (Special Inspection) ialah:
c: Mengesahkan integriti peralatan dengan segera dan menentukan sama ada CF masih sah
e: Regulation 12: purpose – to immediately verify equipment integrity and decide if current CF remains valid or must be revised.

q: Jika keputusan Pemeriksaan Khas ialah 'Bersyarat' (Conditional):
c: Tindakan pembetulan diperlukan dan tempoh sah CF dipendekkan
e: Outcomes: Pass – CF valid; Conditional – corrective actions, CF validity shortened; Fail – CF revoked/suspended.

q: Pertukaran penghuni (change of occupier) menyebabkan:
c: SSI tamat tempoh
e: Expiration of SSI: CF reaches validity limit, non-compliance with Reg. 10 or 11, change of occupier, failure to renew CF on time.

q: Yuran pendaftaran awal SSI meliputi:
c: Semakan dokumen dan pengesahan kelayakan pemeriksa
e: Application fees (Reg. 19): initial registration covers review of documents and verification of competent inspector credentials.

q: Bagi Skim A, yuran pemeriksaan dikenakan:
c: Bagi setiap sesi pemeriksaan kerana kekerapan lebih tinggi
e: Inspection charges: Scheme A – higher frequency, fees per inspection session; Scheme B – fewer inspections but RBI analytical cost.

q: Siapakah yang berkongsi tanggungjawab bagi operasi selamat di bawah fasal umum SSI?
c: Penghuni dan pemeriksa
e: General clauses: only DOSH-registered CPs may inspect; occupiers maintain records; both occupiers and inspectors share responsibility.

q: Dalam kes kren di Jalan Raja Chulan (Ogos 2016), mangsa ialah:
c: Seorang pemandu kereta yang melalui di bawah kren
e: A 1-ton crane hook fell onto a car, crushing and killing the motorist; cause – mechanical failure or inadequate maintenance.

q: Dalam kes Loy-Lange Box Company, kegagalan cincin bawah mencetuskan:
c: BLEVE (Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion)
e: Bottom ring failed upon startup post-maintenance, triggering a BLEVE; vessel launched through roof, 4 killed.

q: Menurut kesimpulan bab, tanggungjawab muktamad bagi pematuhan SSI – dari permohonan hingga pembaharuan – terletak pada:
c: Penghuni (occupier)
e: Conclusion: occupiers carry the ultimate responsibility for compliance – from application to renewal.
